meta.title: Melody with tone()
meta.blurb: tone() drives a passive buzzer through 100 Ω: an arpeggio C E G C, a rest, and a run up to C again.
see: Press run and unmute: the tune plays through the speakers, then repeats after a pause.
The inspector shows the buzzer frequency of each note: 262, 330, 392, 523 Hz …
